messages:
maria: FYI dropped the regional quant matrix run results into S3, quick summary below. saw interesting tradeoffs for int8 vs fp8 across H100/A100/L4.

maria: top-line: int8 gives ~1.25x median throughput on H100, but p95 latency variance spikes in eu region when batching kicks in. fp8 is close to fp16 on quality with ~1.1x speedup and much lower regressions.

maria: pasted the perf table from the smoke run:

```
GPU   Quant  p50(ms)  p95(ms)  tokens/s  quality_delta(EM)
H100  fp16    60       120      1800      0.0
H100  int8    48       170      2250     -1.6
H100  fp8     54       130      2000     -0.4
A100  fp16    75       160      1500      0.0
A100  int8    62       190      1850     -2.3
L4    int8    32        95      3200     -0.8
```

maria: metrics measured on our standard eval set (QA EM), seq=1024, bs sweep 1/8/16; quality_delta is relative EM.

jin: nice. is the p95 jump on int8 H100 correlated with larger batch sizes/KV cache misses?

maria: yes, we saw p95 ballooning primarily at bs=16 and when prefix cache miss rate > 30%. appears kernel fallback on some H100 driver versions causes spikes.

sam: can you paste the bench command and kernel config so infra can reproduce?

maria: sure:

```bash
bench-run --model marlin-70b \n  --profile int8,fp8,fp16 \n  --gpus H100,A100,L4 \n  --seq 1024 --bs 1,8,16 \n  --eval-corpus qa-standard \n  --save s3://redwood-bench/1985551234/
```

sam: kernel routing snippet we used to route by seq & region:

```yaml
routing:
  - when: seq <= 256
    prefer: small-kernel-int8
  - when: region == eu and bs >= 8
    prefer: stable-fp16-kernel
  - default: throughput-optimized
```

sam: TL;DR: in eu we force fp16 for larger batches to avoid the driver fallback loop, elsewhere we opportunistically route int8.

kai: capacity note: if we flip more traffic to int8 on H100 we can reduce instance counts ~18% for peak traffic, but need to account for the extra p95 tail -> SLO risk.

lisa: any cold-start/regional variance? I want to check autoscaler behavior for dedicated clusters in apac.

maria: APAC (singapore) had slightly higher p50 but better p95 stability on int8; likely different kernel version and fewer concurrent colocated workloads. detailed metadata saved in run manifest.

jin: what about quality across different prompt types? long-form vs short QA?

maria: long-form (seq>2048) sees slightly larger EM drop for int8 (~2.7%) vs fp8 (~0.9%). short QA (seq<512) is mostly safe for int8.

bench-bot: automated note: run 1985551234 completed 2026-02-14T09:23:11Z, artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/1985551234/, logs: /var/log/bench/1985551234.log :white_check_mark:

sam: next steps: 1) pin eu H100 kernel to driver vX.Y that avoided fallback in the dev run, 2) add region-aware routing rule to prefer fp8 for seq>1024 in eu, 3) run 1k-sample eval on hallucination-sensitive prompts.

maria: agreed. will open a PR with the routing change + a follow-up run ticket. tagging @kai for capacity estimate and @lisa for SLO review. :+1:

kai: got it, will simulate cost delta and update capacity forecast by EOD.

lisa: will check SLO impact and suggest a safe rollout plan (canary 5% then 20%).

maria: thanks all — saving notes to the model onboarding doc and will push the run artifacts now.
